chip.description: Zooming sprite generator with per-sprite format, window/clipping attributes and two sprite pages; later boards integrate the companion 186 into the same package (taxonomy §4.19 example).
chip.notes: src/mame/shared/namco_c355spr.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("Namco C355/187 Zooming sprites ... earlier titles use the 186/187 pair ... while later boards appear to integrate the 186 into the C355 custom").
